overview_description.description:
SkyLink is a unified travel management and collaboration platform that uses artificial intelligence to automate trip management via email and chat. SkyLink combines their client's existing technology stack and Artificial Intelligence to automate tasks in the same way that a typical TMC agent would.

SkyLink is headquartered in San Francisco, California and was founded in 2021.
